delivery: Unreleased incremental source work. No version bump, commit, push, installer or installation.
scope: Existing scene-preview tab accepts ordinary registered JSON composition recipes and their current exact editor drafts; build scenes remain saved Scene2D only.
Portable read-only resolver reuses shared Rust expansion and the Scene2D model within a detached in-memory clone. Generated world observations and write grants are never exposed.
Actor/group identities and real recipe contributor locations distinguish template, override, offset and identity; inherited projection provenance stays at its original source.

Saved source, draft baseline, world fences and image bytes are checked; malformed drafts retain their last valid picture while stale navigation and delayed responses cannot overwrite current text or canvas.
Chinese, English and Japanese controls; independent remembered preview/build selection and all recipe layout-write actions guarded.

nativeBuilds.actualArchiveMobileAndGodotTests: Included in final app with explicitly supplied real binaries; zero skipped tests.

harnessCorrections: Native helper compilation initially ran before desktop sidecar preparation; retry after pinned Node preparation succeeded. No Rust source repair.
Initial browser assertions sampled selection before native dialog focus restoration finished. The harness now waits for the exact selected JSON token.

Delayed-response probe used statement syntax in an expression-only evaluator and initially waited for a held response before releasing it. Fixed harness expression and open-preview wait mode; final seven-step run passed.
Before-final-UI successful browser/package evidence is retained separately. Final runs cover the frozen template/identity navigation and final recipe caption.
limits: Recipe preview is read-only. Template/override forms, reverse source write-back and automatic baked-scene synchronization remain future work.
Only current registered recipe text is overlaid; dependencies and images use saved versions. Recipes never become executable build snapshots.
Single-file fragments, explicit stable UUID maps, existing Scene2D v3, bounded expansion and ordinary source saving remain unchanged. No nested/cross-file composition or multi-file transaction.
Mobile isolation verifies packaged portable semantics on Linux, not mobile preview UI. No Tauri window, installer acceptance or Android device run in this round.
Production Rust recipe semantics and WASM did not change. Defensive location remapping removes all generated ranges; no unsupported claim of reproducing a separate CST indexing failure.
